purpose: Teach: 図る/プライバシー/改造/浸透/中野/対照/許諾/質的

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、商売の発展を、絶対、図る、絶対、ため、絶対、走り回ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When Dad was starting out, he ran himself ragged — and I mean ragged — to build the business. I'm telling you, he gave everything.
lines.style: Low, measured cadence. Pride threaded through quiet respect. Slight pause before each 'he'. Anchor the weight on 'ragged.' Ends with firm conviction, not nostalgia — a statement of fact earned by time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、プライバシー、絶対、守ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've protected our customers' privacy with absolute seriousness. I'm grateful for that foundation every day.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Each phrase lands with care. Slight emphasis on 'absolute seriousness' — not defensive, but grounded. Voice steady and level. The kind of gratitude that doesn't perform.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、工場の、絶対、改造、絶対、自分で、絶対、設計したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father — he designed the factory renovation himself. All of it. With his own hands and mind. That's the kind of man he was.
lines.style: Slower now. Each sentence shorter. Breath between them. Wonder underneath — the wonder of remembering someone who could do that. Trailing softly on 'that's the kind of man.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、社内、絶対、浸透、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father's spirit — that dedication to quality — it runs through everyone here now. I feel his presence in that, and I'm grateful.
lines.style: Gentle but present. Not speaking over the grandfather's words — building on them. 'Quality' gets a light emphasis. Warm without being sentimental. The voice of someone who understands inheritance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、中野、絶対、地区、絶対、開拓、絶対、最初、絶対、頑張ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we opened the Nakano district — he was the one who did it. He went first. He didn't ask anyone to do what he wouldn't do himself.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet awe. 'He went first' — slight lift, respect. Slow walk through the sentences. Breathing space between thoughts. Ends on conviction, not recitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代と今の、本気で、絶対、対照、絶対、表、絶対、ばあさんと作りました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My grandmother and I — we made a chart comparing his era to now. It shows how far his principles carried us forward.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. 'We made a chart' with light warmth — a shared effort with grandma. Measured pace. Reflective, not heavy. Voice quiet enough to suggest deep thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お取引先の、絶対、許諾、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、取ってきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: He treated every business partner with respect. Every single one. He didn't take permission lightly — he earned it, carefully, every time.
lines.style: Deliberate. Weight on 'every single one' — subtle emphasis that speaks volumes. Slow, almost ceremonial cadence. Ends with the finality of someone describing a principle, not a memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、商売の、絶対、質的、絶対、向上、絶対、目指してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Ever since my father's time, we've aimed for quality in everything we do. That's what he left us — and it's what guides us still.
lines.style: Final phrase. Voice settles into clarity and warmth. 'That's what guides us still' — present tense, grounded. A gentle close that honors the past while standing in the now. Steady breath underneath.
